summary: Russia launched a massive combined missile and drone attack on Kyiv and multiple regions using Geran-5 missiles and reactive Shaheds, with a drone striking the National Academy of Sciences building in Kyiv and wounding a former senior defense official. Ukrainian operation "Vivaldi" captured over 250 Russian soldiers and destroyed battalion-level units. Russian strikes hit critical infrastructure in Izmail, Odesa, and Kyiv region, while Krivoy Rog's mining complex remains largely paralyzed.
key_points: Russia fired 7 guided Geran-5 missiles at Kyiv and Chernihiv regions and deployed reactive Shaheds from multiple directions toward Kyiv, Rivne, Zhytomyr, and Chernihiv. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75884, @mon1tor_ua/75915)

A Russian drone struck the National Academy of Sciences building in Kyiv, wounding former NSDC secretary Gorbulin, prompting criticism of air defense effectiveness. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33577, @UkraineNow/84357)
Ukrainian operation "Vivaldi" captured over 250 Russian personnel, with mechanized units destroying battalion-level formations and capturing officers. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23866)

Russian forces struck Izmail port infrastructure, the Belogorodka storage terminal housing aircraft-type UAVs, and the Usatovo substation powering Odesa port facilities. (Source: @tass_agency/397811, @tass_agency/397813)
Krivoy Rog's major mining and metallurgical enterprises including Arcelor, Inhulets GOK, and Pivdenny GOK are at a standstill, with others operating at 25% capacity. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33589)
EU defense ministers failed to agree on transferring Patriot interceptors from national stockpiles to Ukraine, per EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33572)
Ukraine's government is preparing worst-case infrastructure resilience plans involving underground, cloud, and abroad data storage, per PM Koretsky. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33564)
Budanov warned that North Korea is modernizing its military using Russian combat experience, urging international reaction. (Source: @UkraineNow/84362)

sections.executive_summary: Russia conducted a large-scale missile and drone barrage against Kyiv and western regions, employing Geran-5 missiles and jet-powered Shaheds that penetrated air defenses to hit the National Academy of Sciences building. Ukrainian forces achieved a significant tactical success with operation "Vivaldi," capturing over 250 Russian troops and degrading battalion-level units. Simultaneously, Russian strikes degraded port and energy infrastructure in the south, while Ukraine's industrial heartland in Krivoy Rog faces near-total shutdown.
